decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of 'The Girl on the Train'. The source documents describe three distinct films with this title: the 2013 film (directed by Larry Brand, D1S1), the 2016 film (directed by Tate Taylor, D4S1), and the 2009 film (directed by André Téchiné, D5S3). Since the question does not specify a year, all three directors are valid answers corresponding to different entities sharing the same title. Candidate C3 (Quentin Tarantino) is rejected because D3S1 contains a contradictory label ('Director Quentin Tarantino') which is explicitly identified in D3S2 as a modified context note replacing 'Larry Brand', indicating it is not a factual assertion of a separate film but an artifact of data modification. Therefore, only the three original valid referents are retained.
